findings.evidenceJa: ぱんぱん、と両頬を叩かれる感覚
findings.governingReading: the repeated pan-pan sensation of both cheeks being slapped
findings.explanation: The bilateral, repeated action and sharp sound cue are reduced to a generic slap description.

findings.highlight: if you die trying to save me
findings.evidenceJa: 助けてもらった相手に死なれたら
findings.governingReading: if the person who saved Rin then dies
findings.explanation: Rin’s objection concerns being unable to repay a rescuer who dies afterward; the English makes death part of the rescue attempt itself.

findings.highlight: It vanished when you stepped onto the shadow and fainted.
findings.evidenceJa: 影の上に立って、倒れたと思ったらもういなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou stood on the shadow, and by the time Rin thought he had fallen, it was already gone
findings.explanation: A sequential observation becomes simultaneous disappearance at the moment he steps on the shadow.

findings.evidenceJa: 倒れたと思ったら
findings.governingReading: Rin thought Shirou had fallen or collapsed
findings.explanation: An observed fall is promoted into a diagnosed loss of consciousness.

findings.evidenceJa: 南の空南西の方角に視線を向けて
findings.governingReading: directs her gaze toward the southern sky—toward the southwest
findings.explanation: The movement from broad southern sky to a refined southwest direction disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 随分と長く
findings.governingReading: for what felt like a very long time
findings.explanation: The scale of Shirou’s subjective duration is weakened before Rin reveals that fewer than ten seconds passed.

findings.evidenceJa: 倒れた俺に肩を貸して
findings.governingReading: Saber lends her shoulder to the collapsed Shirou
findings.explanation: The specific support posture disappears.

findings.highlight: I shall treat you as an enemy
findings.evidenceJa: 敵対行為とみなします
findings.governingReading: Saber will regard further approach as a hostile act
findings.explanation: A warning about one action is escalated into declaring Rin an enemy as a person.

findings.highlight: I guess I never told Saber about our current truce.
findings.evidenceJa: 事情を説明して、いなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes he had not explained the circumstances to Saber
findings.explanation: The narration’s broader withheld context is prematurely resolved as the truce alone.

findings.evidenceJa: いま休戦中で
findings.governingReading: they are presently under a ceasefire
findings.explanation: A bounded tactical truce is broadened into peace.

findings.evidenceJa: そういう、約束なんだ
findings.governingReading: that is the agreement between Shirou and Rin
findings.explanation: A mutual arrangement is reassigned to a unilateral promise made by Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方がそう言うのなら
findings.governingReading: if Shirou says so
findings.explanation: Saber’s acceptance of his account is recast in more formal Master-command language.

findings.highlight: the nausea and the chill that tries to get me unconscious
findings.evidenceJa: 吐き気と悪寒で途絶えそうになる意識
findings.governingReading: consciousness threatening to cut out under nausea and chills
findings.explanation: Symptoms are made singular agents that “try to get” Shirou unconscious in malformed English.

findings.highlight: the most that it can do
findings.evidenceJa: 実体のあるモノなら
findings.governingReading: if the thing has material embodiment
findings.explanation: Archer’s ontological condition on his assessment disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 瘧を移された程度だろう
findings.governingReading: he has probably contracted no more than something like ague
findings.explanation: A qualified, archaic fever comparison becomes generic illness and stronger certainty.

findings.highlight: draining the life from the townspeople
findings.evidenceJa: 町の人間から魔力を吸い上げている
findings.governingReading: draining Magical Energy from the townspeople
findings.explanation: The setting’s specific resource is replaced by literal life.

findings.highlight: Archer looks down at me, lying on the ground.
findings.evidenceJa: 他の誰でもない、地に伏した俺に視線を向けた
findings.governingReading: Archer directs his gaze at none other than Shirou, prostrate on the ground
findings.explanation: The marked selection of Shirou over every other person present disappears.

findings.highlight: I’m to fight it after all
findings.evidenceJa: アレの相手をさせられる
findings.governingReading: he is made to deal with that kind of thing after all
findings.explanation: Archer’s broader recurring function is narrowed to combat.

findings.evidenceJa: 守護者
findings.governingReading: Guardian
findings.explanation: A setting-specific status term central to Archer’s identity is presented as an ordinary guarding role.

findings.evidenceJa: そう悲観したものではないか
findings.governingReading: perhaps there is no need to be so pessimistic
findings.explanation: Archer’s reflective qualification is strengthened into an absolute claim about hopelessness.

findings.highlight: because someone told me this is like a disease
findings.evidenceJa: 瘧のようだ、と誰かが言ったせいか
findings.governingReading: perhaps because someone said it was like ague
findings.explanation: The exact fever image prompting Shirou’s hallucinated bodily sensation is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 熱病を持った蚊
findings.governingReading: mosquitoes carrying fever
findings.explanation: The vector and its relation to fever are completely changed into maggots described by an unnatural adjective.

findings.evidenceJa: 体内に発生して
findings.governingReading: arise or breed inside his body
findings.explanation: The hallucinated internal generation mechanism disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: ビッシリと指先まで埋まっている
findings.governingReading: packed densely all the way to his fingertips
findings.explanation: The density and extreme endpoint of the sensation are generalized.

findings.highlight: You’ll hurt Senpai if you hold him like that.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな支え方じゃ、先輩が辛くなる
findings.governingReading: that way of supporting him will make things painful or difficult for Senpai
findings.explanation: Sakura’s concern about strain is strengthened into Saber physically injuring him.

findings.evidenceJa: それだけならよかったのに
findings.governingReading: if only his daily suffering had been the whole of it
findings.explanation: A statement that the situation worsened beyond one problem becomes Sakura’s claim about what she personally could tolerate.

findings.highlight: tonight you’ve brought him home injured
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜は怪我をして帰ってきたんです
findings.governingReading: tonight Senpai returned home injured
findings.explanation: Shirou’s state on return is reassigned to Saber as the agent who brings him back, sharpening Sakura’s blame beyond the wording.

findings.evidenceJa: それが出来ないっていうならせめて
findings.governingReading: if you cannot do that, then at least
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses “can’t” and “please.”

findings.evidenceJa: 寝かしつけて、くれている
findings.governingReading: kindly settling him into bed or attending him until sleep
findings.explanation: Care at the bedside is made to sound like actively inducing unconsciousness.

findings.highlight: Did it apologize, it’s my fault?
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の不注意だ、と謝ったのか
findings.governingReading: did the unidentified person apologize by saying it was their own carelessness?
findings.explanation: The deliberately unidentified human speaker is depersonalized as “it,” while the reported-speech syntax is malformed.

findings.evidenceJa: ごめんなさい、と謝ったのか
findings.governingReading: or did the speaker apologize with “I’m sorry”?
findings.explanation: The second alternative is likewise rendered as an ungrammatical comma splice.

findings.highlight: My consciousness fades as soon as I lie down.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識は横になった事で途切れ
findings.governingReading: lying down cuts off his consciousness
findings.explanation: An abrupt cessation caused by assuming a prone position becomes gradual fading.
